summary: First testing run for AI Router Control Centre. 21/21 backend pytest tests pass against the live external URL, covering health, admin auth (login + JWT enforcement), dashboard metrics, key CRUD (add/list/test/toggle/priority/delete with masking), router chat (success, missing-auth 401, invalid-model no-loop, streaming SSE with [DONE]), automatic failover (bogus higher-priority key -> completion still succeeds, failovers counter incremented, AUTH_FAILED classified in error_breakdown), usage endpoint (per_key + credit-not-shown note), jobs list/detail, health check trigger, structured logs with no credential leakage + status filter, settings GET/PUT persistence, pause/resume, client-keys CRUD (create returns one-time plaintext prefixed sk-router-, list shows only prefixes, rotate returns new plaintext, revoke). Security master check confirms no ciphertext/nonce/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY ever appear in admin API responses. Frontend Playwright verified login with admin token loads dashboard-header, metric strip populates (healthy=2, active_jobs=0, reqs today=11), all 7 nav tabs render, add-key dialog creates key (masked ••••••••XXXX), test-key-button returns AUTH_FAILED toast for fake keys, toggle-key-switch present per row, create-client-key flow reveals a 63-char plaintext once via client-key-reveal, refresh-health-button and settings-save-button both trigger success toasts. No console/page errors detected.

issues: Radix DialogContent warnings (Missing Description/aria-describedby) on Add Key and Create Client Key dialogs - a11y polish only, not blocking

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the Add Key and Create Client Key modal shadcn Dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Router POST /api/v1/chat/completions correctly masks provider key in x_router.key response field.
Admin /keys, /usage, /logs, /jobs, /client-keys responses verified free of ciphertext/nonce/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY plaintext.
Failover engine correctly classifies fake key AUTH_FAILED and fails over to healthy Emergent key; failovers counter increments as expected.
Streaming SSE emits proper OpenAI chunk format terminated by 'data: [DONE]'.
Invalid model requests short-circuit without looping keys (returns error in <45s).
